'''Tom Sokol Thank The Maker''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Tom Sokol]]
* '''Published:''' January 1998 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Cloud City]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Dagobah: Yoda's Hut|Dagobah-L-dagobahyodashut.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Thank The Maker
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PCC Thank The Maker Sokol LS 1998.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

Strategy and Implementation: This deck was designed, not to cause your Dark Side opponent to lose massive Force, but to cause your opponent to lose Force each and every turn. You may wonder why there are no Gas Miners included to add extra drains at the Clouds and speed this deck up, or why there is no Anakin's Lightsaber, or some other way besides force drains and Anger, Fear, Aggression to cause the opponent to lose force. The fact is, you should expect that Imperial Decree would be out and effectively canceling all your force drain bonuses, which would invalidate those cards.

Begin at Dagobah. Pull sites out of your reserve deck each turn till they're all out. Hunt for a Son Of Skywalker and deploy him on Dagobah, with a pair of Electrobinoculars. Then begin seaching for an EG-4 and Cloud City: Incinerator with the Electrobinoculars, if they're not already in your hand. This is where the fun begins. Get Yoda down with Luke, and set up to complete Jedi Test #1: during your activate phase, use Electrobinoculars to find a destiny draw that you can use to complete it. Your opponent's drains are now slowed, giving you time to set up the next part of this deck...

Set up force drains at the Clouds deployed at Dagobah. Use your Electrobinoculars to hunt through your deck, picking up only Starfighters and Clouds and other cards you need. Keep Red Leader in Red 1 and Gold Leader in Gold 1 in your hand, and deploy the Y-Wings and X-Wing at the Bog Clearing, then lift off to the Clouds. It should take a few turns to search through your whole deck and get the cards set up.

Once everything is set up, you can start retrieving Force. Use Electrobinoculars to set up destiny 6 draws on the top. Use an On The Edge, or Off The Edge to retrieve force that you lose. Off The Edge is more effective, since the droid, EG-4, is a destiny 0, and you will retrieve 6 force. On The Edge will only get you only 5. There is one other way to retrieve force, and that is to use Thank The Maker. If the opponent drains for more than 5, you can play this card to randomly retrieve Force equal to a destiny draw. This card is tricky to use, but you can use more than one per turn. You also can use It Could Be Worse to reduce the opponent's Force drains.

This deck has weaknesses though. It can lose to a heavy Scanning Crew Deck. If those are popular in your area, substitute 2 Shocking Informations instead of 2 other cards. This deck can also lose to a deck with lots of Senses in it. You can add What're You Tryin' To Push On Us? and more Controls if those are popular around your area.

Also, the immediate effect There'll Be Hell To Pay can hurt you. If they get those off on more than one of your Force retrieval cards, you'll have some trouble, but if they get it on only 1, you're ok. If you're scared of There'll Be Hell To Pay, you can use It Can Wait, and they'll have to use it on the first interrupt played during their next turn, if played by either player (so they may be forced to use There'll Be Hell To Pay on themselves).

Hopefully you saved Red Leader in Red 1 and Gold Leader in Gold 1 in your hand (if not, go through your deck and get them with Elecrobinoculars). By now, you can tell if they are playing lots of space or not. If they are, you'll be able to deploy both of them at the system they are weakest, search for a 6 destiny on the Top, and battle. They'll have to lose a lot to attrition because of the high destiny. You'll be able to retrieve the Rebel Leaders if you lose them in engagements. They are to be used as tools to slow down your opponent.

If the opponent is not doing space, then you can drain for 3 (2 if Imperial Decree is active) at Kessel all game. The Anger, Fear, Aggressions will hurt your opponent a lot unless they battle you. Your Force retrieval cards will get them back for you and allow you to do it again.

This deck is slow, but it gets constant drains going which cause the opponent to lose Force. You'll be able to keep the edge with On/ Off The Edge and electrobinoculars getting tons of Force back. If this deck works, then you should have a small lost pile at the end of the game, meaning a large differential for you.
